column1: # p475 control: is "any later version" present in the STOCK GPL-family payload regardless of a project's election?
# Method: fetch the grant payload first-hand from raw.githubusercontent.com, count occurrences of the literal string.
# If the count is non-zero for every payload, then grading or-later FROM THE PAYLOAD is a uniform false positive.
# RESULT: 3 of 3. The string lives in the preamble and in the "How to Apply These Terms" appendix,
# which are part of the stock licence text and are NOT the project's election.
# The real election lives in per-source-file headers (e.g. "either version 3 ... or (at your option) any later version"
# as applied by the project) or in packaging metadata -- NOT in the LICENSE payload.
